items.t: Said that families' struggles to keep up with bills should be on legislators' minds when they vote on taxes and spending.
items.q: When a family tells us their paycheck isn't keeping up with their bills, that needs to be on our minds when we vote on taxes and spending.

items.t: Outlined a plan to address migrant detention capacity as border enforcement increases.
items.q: Senator Kavanagh outlines a plan to address migrant detention capacity as border enforcement increases.

items.t: Said legislators need to be at the table working on a solution when rural communities worry about having enough water to grow.
items.q: When a rural community is worried about whether it'll have enough water to grow, we need to be at the table working on a solution.

items.t: Outlined plans to house teachers in closed schools.
items.q: Sen. Kavanagh outlines plans to house teachers in closed schools

record.t: Was elected Senate Minority Leader for the 58th Legislature by Arizona Senate Republicans.
record.q: Arizona Senate Republicans today elected Senator John Kavanagh as Minority Leader for the 58th Legislature in 2027

record.t: Served as Senate Majority Leader and as Senate President Pro Tempore.
record.q: The Fountain Hills Republican has served as Senate Majority Leader, as well as Senate President Pro Tempore

record.t: Chaired appropriations committees in both chambers of the Legislature.
record.q: and chaired appropriations committees in both chambers.

record.t: Served six years on the Fountain Hills town council and three years on the Lafayette, New Jersey Town Council.
record.q: He served six years as a town councilman in Fountain Hills and three years on the Lafayette, New Jersey Town Council.

record.t: Said he would delay his bill that would make it a misdemeanor to use a public facility not associated with one's birth gender.
record.q: Republican Rep. John Kavanagh said Wednesday he would delay his bill that seeks to make it a misdemeanor for anyone to use a public facility not associated with their birth gender.

record.t: Led an effort to eliminate SNAP payment errors and fraudulent claims in Arizona's government assistance programs.
record.q: Senator Kavanagh leads effort to eliminate SNAP payment errors and fraudulent claims in Arizona's government assistance programs.

record.t: Sponsored a bill that would require schools to use students' real names.
record.q: Sen. Kavanagh's bill would require schools to use students' real names
